text: If you didn't select a port because you didn't see your device listed, try the following steps:
如果串口列表中没有您的设备，请按以下步骤检查：
Make sure that the device is connected to this computer (the one that runs the browser that shows this website)
确认开发板已通过 USB 连接到当前打开此网页的电脑。
Most devices have a tiny light when it is powered on. If yours has one, make sure it is on.
如果开发板带有电源指示灯，请确认指示灯亮起。亮灯仅表示有供电，不代表 USB 数据连接正常。
Make sure that the USB cable you use can be used for data and is not a power-only cable.
确认 USB 线支持数据传输，不能使用仅供充电的线。可尝试更换数据线，并直接连接电脑的 USB 接口。
Make sure you have the right drivers installed. Below are the drivers for common chips used in ESP devices:
确认串口驱动正常。ESP32-C3 原生 USB 串口通常使用 Windows 自带驱动；只有使用下列 USB 转串口芯片的开发板，才需要对应驱动：
Connect your device to the network to start using it.
请先将设备连接到 WiFi 网络。
Do you want to reset your device and erase all user data from your device?
确定要重置设备并清除所有用户数据吗？
phrase: If you are using a Linux flavor, make sure that your user is part of the
如果使用 Linux，请确认当前用户已加入
group so it has permission to access the device.
用户组，以获得访问串口设备的权限。
You may need to log out & back in or reboot to activate the new group access.
修改用户组后，可能需要注销并重新登录，或重启电脑才能生效。

安装 ${this._manifest.name} 前，是否擦除设备数据？勾选后，设备上的所有数据都会丢失。
Keep this page visible to prevent slow down
请保持此页面在前台显示，以免安装速度变慢。
All data on the device will be erased.
设备上的所有数据都将被擦除。
Serial port is not readable/writable. Close any other application using it and try again.
无法读写串口。请关闭占用该串口的其他程序，然后重试。
无法下载固件清单，请检查网络连接后重试。
Serial port is not ready. Close any other application using it and try again.
串口尚未就绪。请关闭占用该串口的其他程序，然后重试。

初始化失败。请重启设备，或按住 BOOT 键后点击“安装”，进入下载模式后重试。

Your browser does not support installing things on ESP devices. Use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
当前浏览器不支持 ESP 设备烧录，请使用桌面版 Chrome 或 Edge。
You can only install ESP devices on HTTPS websites or on the localhost.
请通过 HTTPS 或本机 localhost 地址打开此页面，才能使用串口烧录。
